 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 14, 2026, 09:34:21 IST SUMMARY India vs Pakistan, U19 Asia Cup Final Live Score: India will be eyeing a stronger support for lead performers Aaryavir Sehwag and Ishan Sood to tame defending champions Pakistan in the final and reclaim the Under-19 Asia Cup in Al Amerat Oman, on Saturday. 
 Pakistan had beaten India by 151 runs last year for their second title while the boys in blue will be hunting for their record-extending ninth trophy. 
 Aaryavir, son of former India opener Virender Sehwag, has amassed 303 runs from four matches at an average of 101 with a hundred and two fifties to lead the tournament's run chart so far. 
 The strapping Sood has used his considerable pace to good effect to take 11 wickets from four matches, guiding India's bowling unit. Commentary 
 Scorecard 
 09:34 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: Hamza Zahoor eyes another big knock against India Pakistan batter Hamza Zahoor will be keen to repeat his performance from the group-stage match against India. He scored a century in that game, which Pakistan won, and will once again face the Indian bowling attack in the final. Pakistan have other batting options too, with Usman Khan leading their run-scoring charts with 238 runs from four innings. India will need to keep Zahoor in check and avoid allowing him to settle at the crease in another important match. 09:21 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: India's spinners must step up alongside Ishan Sood Ishan Sood has done much of the work for India's bowling attack, but the fast bowler will need support from the spinners in the final against Pakistan. Arjun Rajput and Manal Chauhan have taken five wickets each in the tournament, although three of those wickets came in a single match. India will need them to contribute more regularly, especially if Pakistan's batters get through Sood's opening spell. Their ability to control the middle overs could prove important in the title clash. 08:47 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: Rizwanullah leads Pakistan's bowling challenge Pakistan fast bowler Rizwanullah has been among the leading performers with the ball in the tournament. He has taken 11 wickets in four matches at an average of 12 and has registered a five-wicket haul. His best figures of 5/30 came against Bangladesh in the semifinal, when Pakistan bowled their opponents out for 138. Rizwanullah shares the top spot on the wicket-takers' list with India's Ishan Sood.  08:06 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: Pakistan's Usman Khan poses a major batting threat Pakistan will rely on Usman Khan to deliver with the bat in the Under-19 Asia Cup final. He has scored 238 runs in four innings at an average of 119, including a century and a half-century. Usman is second on the tournament's run-scoring chart, behind India's Aaryavir Sehwag. His performances have played a key role in Pakistan's journey to the final. The contest between the two leading run-scorers could have a major impact on the title clash. 08:03 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: India need more batters to support Sehwag While Aaryavir Sehwag has been consistent with the bat, India will need more contributions from the rest of the batting line-up in the final. Captain Lakshya Raichandani, wicketkeeper-batter Anvay Dravid, and middle-order batters Arjun Rajput and VK Vinneeth have shown their ability in patches. Rajput scored a century against Pakistan in the group stage, while Raichandani made 93 against Afghanistan in the semifinal. India will need more such efforts on Saturday. 08:01 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: Ishan Sood spearheads India's bowling attack against Pakistan Ishan Sood has been India's leading wicket-taker in the tournament, claiming 11 wickets in four matches. The right-arm fast bowler has used his pace to trouble opposition batters and has delivered whenever captain Lakshya Raichandani has handed him the ball. Sood's best figures in the competition are 4/37, and he currently shares the top spot on the wicket-takers' list with Pakistan's Rizwanullah. India will need another strong performance from him to challenge Pakistan's batting line-up. 🏏 Cricket Match Prediction What will the toss-winning team choose?  08:01 (IST) Nov 14 Ind vs Pak Live Score: Aaryavir Sehwag leads India's charge with the bat Aaryavir Sehwag has been India's leading batter in the tournament and will be one of the players to watch in the final against Pakistan. The son of former India opener Virender Sehwag has scored 303 runs in four matches at an average of 101. His tally includes one century and two half-centuries, making him the leading run-scorer in the tournament. India will hope he can continue his form in the title clash and give the team a strong start. 08:00 (IST) Nov 14 India vs Pakistan Live Score: India eye record-extending ninth Under-19 Asia Cup title India will take on defending champions Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup final in Al Amerat, Oman, on Saturday. The Indian team will be aiming to reclaim the continental title and extend its record to nine trophies. Pakistan, meanwhile, will look to retain the crown after beating India by 151 runs in last year's final to win their second title. Both teams have reached the summit clash after convincing victories in the semifinals, setting up another contest between the arch-rivals. For Pakistan, Usman Khan (238 runs) and pacer Rizwanullah (11 wickets) are the top performers, and Hamza Zahoor, who made a 100 against India at the league stage, will be eager to repeat that effort.
Apart from Rizwanullah, Pakistan also have in-form Mohammad Sayyam (8) and Ali Raza (6 wickets) in their efficient bowling ranks.
